cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high position with the gripper pointing upward and performs a rhythmic side-to-side waving motion using the elbow and wrist joints.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: A quick, attentive lift of the arm to acknowledge a person or signal for attention. The motion is sharp and ends at a high, visible posture.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot transitions to an upright posture and then performs a slow, controlled arc downward and forward, holding the final low position to show formal respect.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot prepares its arm by orienting the gripper vertically, then extends it forward in a steady, inviting motion, holding the reach to wait for a handshake.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertical gripper orientation and performs a rhythmic up-and-down shaking motion from the elbow to simulate a handshake.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm sweeps across its chest and points the gripper back toward its own body in a self-comforting, hugging gesture.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot brings its gripper to its face area, performs a quick 'kissing' wrist movement, and then sweeps the arm forward and upward in a graceful arc to release the kiss.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot reaches high above its head and traces two large arcs in the air to outline the lobes of a heart, followed by a double-pulse motion to simulate a heartbeat.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot moves its gripper inward to rest near its chest, signaling sincerity, internal reflection, or a heartfelt 'thank you'.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm performs a triumphant celebration by pulling back into a 'wind-up' pose and then thrusting the fist high into the air with an energetic shake at the top.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot arm raises high into a cocked position and then performs a sharp, high-speed downward pull to celebrate a victory or express agreement.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot moves its arm out to the side, snaps it into a bicep curl position, and trembles slightly to show the effort of flexing, holding the peak pose to demonstrate strength.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot positions its gripper at eye level pointing forward, then performs a rhythmic series of vertical wrist tilts to simulate a head nodding in agreement.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot moves its arm to a central position and performs a sharp, repetitive side-to-side rotation of the wrist to signal 'no' or disagreement.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot mimics a human shrug by quickly raising its upper arm assembly while rotating the grippers to a palm-up position, holding the pose to convey uncertainty.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its hand to its head and performs a quick scratching motion with its wrist to signal uncertainty or confusion.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot moves its gripper to a high, centered position and then slowly tilts it to the side, mimicking a human tilting their head when intrigued or confused.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper to its 'forehead' in a sharp motion and holds it there, followed by a slow, weary downward slide to signal deep frustration or disbelief.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot moves its arm to center-chest height with the gripper pointing toward itself, then performs a double-tapping motion to signify 'me'.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot extends its arm directly forward in an assertive pointing motion, finishing with a sharp jab to emphasize the subject.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented horizontally (palm down) and repeatedly curls its wrist inward to gesture for someone to approach.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot raises its arm with the gripper oriented vertically to mimic a human palm, then pushes forward firmly and holds the position to signal an authoritative 'stop' or 'halt' command.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot arm raises to a high, central position with the gripper tip pointing straight up, followed by a sharp micro-movement to emphasize the importance of the gesture.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its gripper to its face level in a vertical orientation and holds it centered in front of its 'lips' to command silence.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its hand to its midsection, pointing the gripper toward itself, and performs a light, repetitive patting motion against its torso.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot reaches across its chest with the gripper pointing toward its own body and performs a rapid, repetitive rubbing motion on its upper arm/shoulder area to signal it is cold.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its gripper to head height and performs a rapid, repetitive fanning motion towards itself to signal that it is hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot simulates a yawn by lifting its arm toward its head area and then covering its 'mouth' with the gripper in a lateral orientation, accompanied by a slight sleepy tremor.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot brings its gripper up to the side of its head and performs a small, repetitive scrubbing motion near its eye before letting the arm linger heavily to signal exhaustion.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: A formal and sincere deep bow. The arm moves in a slow, controlled arc from an upright position to a deep forward lean, holding the lowest point to express regret or deep respect.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot arm raises to a high lateral position with the gripper pointing up, then performs two quick wrist-flexing motions to simulate air quotes.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head and uses its gripper to tap its 'temple' twice, suggesting intelligence or a clever idea.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot arm moves to the side of its head and uses the wrist to perform several small circular rotations, indicating a 'crazy' or 'spinning thoughts' gesture.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot raises its gripper to the side of its mouth and slides it horizontally across to the other side in a quick zipping motion, concluding with a sharp wrist turn to signal the secret is locked.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot arm sweeps across its torso and tucks close to the chest, simulating a defensive, closed-off posture.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot mimics an assertive stance by flaring its elbow and planting its gripper firmly at waist height on its side.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and slightly downward to simulate leaning in, while rotating its gripper to a horizontal orientation to signal receptivity and engagement.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot arm performs a sudden recoil, pulling back toward the body and lifting the gripper high with a horizontal orientation to simulate palms facing outward in surprise, followed by a slight tremor.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper to its 'face' area, pointing the tip toward itself to mimic a shocked gasp or an accidental slip of the tongue.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper to a central vertical position mimicking a prayer gesture, then performs a slow, deliberate downward tilt of the arm to signify a respectful bow.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot lifts its arm to chest height with the gripper oriented vertically as if holding a glass, then performs a sharp upward wrist flick to simulate a 'clink' or celebratory toast.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot lifts its arm in an upward arc and presents its gripper vertically at head height, holding the position to invite a high-five interaction.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its gripper high with the 'palm' facing forward, then executes a fast, sharp downward swing to simulate a high-five contact in mid-air.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot arm raises and extends forward with a vertical gripper orientation, performing a slight forward nudge to invite a fist bump and holding the position.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot positions its arm in a vertical 'fist' posture and performs two rhythmic downward strikes against an imaginary palm, holding the final contact to signal agreement or readiness.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot reaches its arm up and back toward its shoulder area, then performs a rhythmic patting motion to simulate self-encouragement or a job well done.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and traces two complete circles in a vertical plane, signaling repetition or a circular concept.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot brings its gripper to its neck area and performs a sharp, horizontal slicing motion to indicate 'stop' or 'cut'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot brings its hand under its chin with the gripper pointing toward itself, then quickly flicks the hand outward and away in a sharp, dismissive gesture.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot lowers its arm to a resting height and performs rapid, small-scale wrist oscillations to simulate the impatient tapping of fingers on a surface.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm with the palm facing up and repeatedly curls its hand toward its body in a beckoning motion to request an item.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot extends its arm forward from a retracted position at a slow, deliberate speed, keeping the gripper horizontal to simulate an open palm offering something to the user.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot quickly thrusts its arm upward to a high position lateral to the head, palms forward, and holds the position to signal submission or surrender.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to the side of its head and presses its gripper against its 'ear' repeatedly, then holds the position to block out noise.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot arm starts from a centered, neutral position and sweeps outward in a broad, welcoming arc, finishing with the arm extended wide and the gripper oriented horizontally to signify a gesture of inclusion and greeting.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot reaches its arm to its maximum vertical height with a slow, deliberate motion, incorporating a subtle side-to-side wiggle to simulate a satisfying physical stretch.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot performs a crisp military salute by snapping its gripper up to the temple area with a flat, vertical orientation and holding the position with formal rigidity.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot places its gripper horizontally above its brow level to act as a visor and performs a slow lateral sweep to scan the horizon.
